Axar Patel Becomes First Indian Spinner to Take 100 Test Wickets

Axar Patel achieved a significant milestone in the India vs. England Test series by taking his 100th Test wicket. This achievement makes him the first Indian spinner to reach this landmark in Test cricket. The event occurred during the ongoing series against England.
